(103)gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor lung a nu yo ga'i rgyud don gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/(104)na mo gu ra we/

tei:div.tei:p: (103)gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor lung a nu yo ga'i rgyud don gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (104)

na mo gu ra we/ dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i lang tsho la/ mkhyen rab rmad byung snang bas legs 'khyud cing*/ rnam pa kun ldan mkhyen pa'i gter gcig pu/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ lung don ut+pal gsar ba'i nags ma'i tshal/ dmar ser ral pa snum pa'am bcud len 'di/ rkang drug blo gsal rnams kyi nyer 'tsho'i phyir/ byin rlabs sbrang rtse gsar ba'i dga' ston spro/ 'dir gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi mdo rgyud sems gsum la bka' bab snga phyi bar gsum du grags pa'i bka' bab bar ma'i rig 'jin rtsal chen rdzogs pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ āḥ ma 'dres yongs rjogs dkon mchog gsum/ sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'chang*/ kun bzang don gyi bla ma la/ mnyam rdzogs chen por skyabs su 'chi/ ā/ (105)ye nas bde gshegs snying po las/ rnam rtog las kyis sprul pa'i 'gro bde sdug yul la spyod pa rnams/ don dam nges par sems bskyed de/ āḥ thabs dang shes rab mtshon cha yis/ dngos dang dngos med thams cad gcod/ me chu rlung dang nam mkha'i khams/ 'khor los mtshan ma'i rtog pa srung*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ting 'jin ni/ āḥ snang ba sems kyi lung yin pas/ ma 'dres bye brag thams cad kun/ ngo bo nyid nas ma skyes pa/ mi gnas mi dmigs spros dang bral/ srid pa ye shes gsang ba'i lung*/ gzung 'jin mtshan rtog bral ba la/ kun 'byung sems kyi dbyings nyid las/ 'gags med rang rtsal cir yang 'char/ rol pa 'byung ba'i lus chen po/ ji ltar (106)rtogs goms 'byung ba ni/ stong pa yum gyi rang bzhin du/ dmar gsal chos 'byung bsnol ba'i dbus/ snang ba yab kyi cha 'jin la/ dman pa'i tha snyad las 'das pa/ brdal ba chen po'i nyi zla dang*/ rtog med bam gyi gdan steng du/ rnal 'byor rtsal chen rjogs pa'i sa/

mngon gyur gnubs kyi rig pa 'jin/ sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che/ ya ma ri dang gnyis su med/ gcer bu thal chen rus pas brgyan/ gdengs thabs rdo rje phur pa bsnams/ smug nag bde chen he ru ka/ zhugs me rdo rje'i thog mda' dang*/ 'bar ba'i tsha tshwa skar ltar 'phro/ smug 'bol ral ba'i lcang lo can/ gser dang rus pa'i snyan yob 'phyang*/ thugs kar gsang ba'i be'u'i dbyings/ dbang (107)rtags gser gyi rdo rje yi/ lte bar pad zla nyi ma'i steng*/ ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ mtshams sprin gsar ba'i kha dog can/ sna tshogs dbang po gzhu yi 'khyud/ longs spyod rjogs pa'i chas kyis spras/ mi gnas rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad rgyas/ shes rab ral gri po ti 'chang*/ nyi ma 'char ga'i dkyil ltar mjes/ dwangs ma'i mtsho la gza' skar bzhin/ rol pa'i phyag rgya cir yang 'char/ rang bzhin dbyings kyi byin rlabs las/ ma bskyed rjogs pa'i tshul du gsal/ āḥ cho 'phrul chen po'i phyag rgya bzhis/ dus bzhi rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ rang snang dbyer med bla ma'i tshogs/ (108)rnal 'byor dam tshig nye bar dgongs/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra sa ma jaḥ ja hūm̐ baṃ ho/ hūm̐/ skye med 'gags pa med pa nyid/ mnyam pas mnyam pa'i don mthong zhing*/ mnyam rjogs dbyings dang ye shes pa/ kun rig rjogs pa'i ngang du bzhugs/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes lta sgom gyi don gsal btab nas/ zhing khyad par can la brten te tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni/ aḥ chos nyid mu med brdal ba'i klong*/ ji bzhin pa yi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rnal 'byor sgrub po'i kun gzhi la/ phyogs ris med la phyag 'tshal lo/ ho/ ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pas na/ rtog pa bral bas phyag 'tshal lo/ log pa'i lta ba rnam dag pa'i/ de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul/ bdag dang bdag gir 'jin pa yi/ mi dge'i (109)dri ma dbyings su bshags/ mkha' ltar khyab pa'i ye shes la/

bya btsal med par rjes yi rang*/ 'gro drug gdul bya thams cad la/ 'byung chen snyoms pa'i chos 'khor bskor/ nyi ma lta bu'i thugs rje yis/ mtha' dbus bri bkol med par bzhugs/ gnyid sad pa yi skyes bu bzhin/ rnam rtog mi mnga' sa ler bsngo/ zhes 'dra mthun don 'phags pa'i mchod pa dang*/ khyad par lung gi mchod pa ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das snang srid snod bcud dang*/ zhen gnyis snang chos 'di dag kun/ gang yang spang len 'gags med pas/ kun tu bzang po'i rol ba'i rgyan/ sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ sku lnga ye shes klong du mchod/ gtsang dme 'jin rtog med par bzhes/ dug lnga (110)dug gsum nyon mongs chos/ skye ba med pa'i klong du mchod/ 'gags med rang byung nyid du bzhes/ 'dod yon ma spang rol pa'i rgyan/ gnyis chos bral ba'i mchod pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po'i klong du mchod/ kun bzang yum gyi ngang du bzhes/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub stsol/ thig le gcig tu 'grub par shog oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā ha la pañtsa pū ja ho/ de nas yon tan rjes dbu dran pas bstod pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ e ma ho/ mkhyen rab rdo rje rnon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ gdul dka'i gshed du khros pa gshin rje gshed/ 'phags pa'i yul na shan pa me ru rtse/ drag sngags dmod pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ slar yang sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ bsam bzhin gnubs rigs gsal (111)ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ mchims bza' mkha' 'gro'i sras su bltams pa'i tshe/ lha mi'i ngo mtshar 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ yab kyi rdo rjes khri gtsug btsan gsol zhing*/ dgung bdun bzhes nas dpal gyi gzhon nu las/ 'bri klog gnang bas ma lus thugs chud cing*/ shes rab phyogs med shar la gsol ba 'debs/ rgyu 'bras zab mos khyed kyi thugs 'phrog nas/ nges 'byung bsam pas za hor mkhan po las/ yongs rdzogs sdom pa bzhes nas bslab pa la/

gus pa'i mchog tu gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ bal po'i rgyal po bsam yas zhabs bkod tshe/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas man ngag zhus/ slar yang yam bu'i tshal du shog ces gsungs/ dam (112)ba'i thugs la btags la gsol ba 'debs/ sgra bsgyur gling du rgya bal paṇa chen bsten/ mdo sngags chos tshul bsgyur zhus gtan la phab/ skye bas thob pas don bsgyur 'ba' zhig mjad/ lo tsā chen por grags la gsol ba 'debs/ slar yang snying stobs go cha mi dman pas/ gser gyi phyag rten bzung nas bal yul phyin/ bā su dha ras rgyud dang man ngag dang*/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags mang du gnang*/ gdams pa'i chu bo rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ rgya bal gnas dang bru sha'i paṇa chen rnams/ bsten pa'i lung bstan dam pa'i bka' las thob/ chos rgyal skyong dang raṃ bu gu h+ya sogs/ yongs 'jin du ma bsten la gsol ba 'debs/ tshe btsan skyes las spyi mdo dgongs 'dus dang*/ dur (113)khrod khu byug rol ba'i mdo la sogs/ rgyud dang phra mo drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ ma lus thugs su chud la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ bam chen gsang ba chen po'i dbang thob cing*/ ma gshin dregs pa'i stong srog gcig char zin/ gshed skor du ma bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ mchod rten lus la bkod nas sgrub pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag pos rjes bzung zhing*/ las kyi gshin rje drug khri'i srog snying phul/ dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ rgya bal ru mtshams rdo rje'i phug pa ru/ gu rus rjes bzung dbang dang gdams pa byin/ dngos grub mtsho gling mi min drag po'i gnas/ sgrub pas yi dam dpag (114)med zha gzigs nas/ byin rlabs dngos grub brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ rdo rje gdan du tshogs dpon mjad pa'i tshe nam mkha'i dkyil nas gser gyi rdo rje bab/ phyag mthil bzhugs pa'i phyag na rdo rje gyur/

rgyud lung man ngag bdag por mnga' gsol zhing*/ mtshan gyi cod pan dpyangal gsol ba 'debs/ dur khrod chen po phung lung nag po ru/ e ka ja ris zhal gzigs dngos grub rdzas/ bram ze mi yi thod pa dngos su byin/ mkha' 'gros gtad rgya thob la gsol ba 'debs/ 'bum phrag drag cu'i stonapa dga' rab rjes/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du rjes bzung zhing*/ sems klog man ngag sde gsum smin grol gyi/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs rjogs la gsol ba 'debs/ bsam yas mchims (115)phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du/ gu ru sgrub chen bka' brgyad rig 'jin du/ rje 'bangs thugs kyi dbu dgu smin pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal sku yi dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ gnyis med dngos grub brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ sgrub khang ya ma'i mkhar la mjad pa'i dus/ rlung sems dbang thob nyi zla gdan du bting*/ mthu stobs chen pos brag la phur pa btab/ grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs la gsaul ba 'debs/ nyug gi ri la snang bzhi mthar phyin tshe/ khengs log byung bas sgrags lha'i rtse mo ru/ nye 'byed nag po rlung gi 'khor lo bskor/ grong khyer sum cu rtsa bdun brlag sku dgra rtsad nas 'byin la gsol ba 'debs/ dpon sras dar mas bstan pa bshig pa na/ spu gri (116)reg gcod drag sngags tshags chud nas/ mngon spyod thugs rjes mtshams sbyar dgongs lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gdul byar gzigs nas mngon spyod la btsams pas na/ rlabs chen thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal pos tshod brgam dri rmed byas pa na/ phyag por rtse nas lcag sdig g.yag rog tsam/ sprul nas dgra mo hūm̐ sgra nyil gyi bshig sdig can dpa' bkong mjad sngags rdom ma nyams pa 'di'i bka' drin yin la gsol ba 'debs/ snye mo bye mkhar sku dgra bod pa na/ lha 'dre dpang btsug bden brdar chos gos brdab/ dam can dregs pa'i dmags tshogs dngos su 'dus/ srung ma las su tshul la gsol ba 'debs/

chos gos grwa nas sing lding phur pa bton/ dmag gi ri la btab pas me 'bar zhing*/ ri bsnyel nyams pa can rnams rtsad nas bcad/ mthu stobs dbang phyug khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ bslu (117)med rgyu 'bras khyad da mi gsod phyir/ bstan ma mig gis sgron ma bshags par brtsams/ bsgral tshad rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du drangs/ 'brel tshad don ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ gnyag dang sog po dpal gyi ye shes las/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rgyud dang man ngag gi gdams pa che phra ma lus tshang bar byas/ bka' bab bar mar grags la gsol ba 'debs/ mun pa'i go cha rdo rje'i rgya mdud sogs/ rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs don ma 'khrul ba/ legs bshad mang po bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag rnam dpyod mtshungs med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ mdo sgyu sems gsum rgyud dang man ngag gi smin grol chu bo bzhi yis gangs can gyi/ skal ldan skye bo sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs la (118)'god pa'i slob dpon chen por gsol ba 'debs/ rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i gsang lam nas/ 'ja' lus 'od gsal dwangs ma'i skur bzhengs nas/ kun bzang chos sku'i go 'phang mngon du mjad/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes yon tan dran pas bstod nas/ de nas rlung sngags sems gsum dbyer mi byed pa'i dmigs pas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ āḥ gzung 'jin rang grol sgyu ma'i gzhal yas khang*/ gdos bcas rang dag bla ma'i thugs kyi klong*/ mi shig gzhom med sngags kyi thig le'i dbus/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i tshon gang ba'i/ thugs kar gnam lcags ral gri'i mchang bzung steng*/ rig pa ye shes dhīḥyig dmar gsal mthar/ rig gdangs lug rgyud sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ 'od zer 'phros pas (119)phyi nang snod bcud sbyangs/ bde gshegs byin rlabs rtsa gsum dngos grub byin/ sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan thig le'i gzugs/ grangs med char bzhin babs te gnas gsum du/

thim pas lha dang phreng phyag mtshan thig le'i gzugs/ grangs med char bzhin babs te gnas gsum du/ thim pas lha dang mi gnyis dngos grub thob/ ces sngags kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba/ sngags 'di stong phrag drug gis ni/ mtshan ma'i bag chags sgrig pa sbyangs/ 'ja' 'od kha dog ring bsrel 'byung*/ zhes dang rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge drug pa 'gro drug las sgrol bar byed pa'i bdag nyid bsam gyi mi khyab par zla med pa'i rdzu 'phrul che ba/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad dang*/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi sdug bsngal las sgrol bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyis bzod dka' ba/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mi gos pa/ srid pa'i las thams cad sbyong bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skyed par byed pa/ ma rungs pa thams cad zlog par byed pa/ (120) sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su yi rang bar byed pa/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byed pa 'jam dpal gyi bstan pa la sngags kyi mchog de gang zhe na/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ zhes brjod nas bzlas par bya'o/ de nas spyi mdo dgongs 'dus las rig 'jin spyi dril gyi snying po/ oṃ ma hā gu ru sha ri raṃ ghi li hūm̐/ zhes bzla'o/ rgyud de nyid las rtse gcig bzlas pa gsum gi rgyud/ grangs med bar chad med par bzla/ de yi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ tshe 'dir rig 'jin sa la gnas/ rgyal ba dag dang mnyam par 'gyur/ zhal nas byung ba'i yon tan yang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi don spyod pas/ sems dpa' che ltar 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes sogs bzlas pa'i phan yon smos kyis mi ldong bar gsungs so/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba rjogs rim bsgom pa ni/ āḥ phyir rol rten gyi snang ba gzhal yas khang*/ brten pa lha tshogs sgyu ma'i rol bar blta/ rtog pas (121)ma bslad stong gsal so mar bzhag

rang bzhin mnyam pa chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes brjod nas mi rtog dgongs pa'i don gsal btab la mnyam par bzhag de nas rlung sngags kyi rjogs rim dngos la/ rang lus bla ma'i sku snang stong me long gi gzugs brtan lta bur gsal ba'i dbus drang por dbu ma mtshan nyid yongs su rjogs pa drang tha ler spyi bor zug pa'i lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng a thung las me 'bar nas dbu ma'i nang na khyug gis 'bar spyi bo'i ham̐ la phog pas de las bdud rtsi babs pas a thung la phog pas me yi gsos byas nas me cher 'bar bas lus phyi nang thams cad gang ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs/ shes rab ye shes kyi snang ba cher rgyas par bsam la/ bum pa can la 'bad pas chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab rgyas pa la man ngag gnad du che/ mthar ni/ āḥ phyi nang lha dang gzhal yas (122)gsal ba nyid/ thugs ka'i 'od khyis brtan g.yo 'od du zhu/ 'od gsal stong pa chen po'i ngang nyid du/ 'jin med spros dang bral ba nyid du gyur/ slar yang sgyu ma'i rol pa cir yang 'char/ kun bzang blal ma'i gsang ba gsum du shar/ ji ltar 'dul ba gdul bya'i 'gro ba la/ rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang*/ ral gris 'khor lo drag tu bskor bar bgyi/ sdug bsngal bden pa lha yi rgyas thob cing*/ kun 'byung 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa/ rang byung ye shes lam gyis dbang bsgyur nas/ khyab bdag 'jam dpal go 'phang thob par shog

ces bsam mo/ de ltar gnub kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig sdom brtson dam pa sangs rgyas bstan 'jin gyi bskul ngor bla ma'i byin rlabs las rang shar bcos slad ma byas par chos smra ba/ btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos thol byung du bris pas byin rlabs gyi bab dang ldan pa yin par sems so/ (123) de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gcan zan gyi sags pa'i steng du bde skyong gi snod du bshams te/ hūm̐/ bden gnyis dag pa dbyer med la/ ma dag pa zhes srid ming med/ gal te yod par gyur pa na/ rig pa'i rlabs kyis rdul du rlog hūm̐ bzhis bgegs bsal nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje nyi ma rtag pa'i rgyud/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga/ cho 'phrul gsum gyi bzhu btul bas/ 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' gang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis brlabs te mchod spṛn bsam gyis mi khyab par spel nas/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'jin chos kyi sku/ 'jam dpal zhi khro longs spyod rjogs/ gnas yul ḍāk+ki sprul pa'i sku/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams/ dbyings nas sgyu ma'i rnam rol du/ tshogs kyi (124)zhing 'dir spyan 'dren na/ mos pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra sa ma ya ja: jaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ de nas tshogs phud ni/ oṃ bza' bca' btung myong phyi yi tshogs/ 'dod yon rnam lnga nang gi tshogs/ lha mo gzungs ma gsang ba'i tshogs/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i zhing du 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba pañtsa pū ja ga ṇa tsakra ho/ bar bshags pa n-i/ ye nas bde gshegs snying po la/ ma rig 'khrul bas bsgribs pa rnams// rang shes rig pas mthol zhing bshags/ dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub rtsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tha ma bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ 'jam dpal rnon po'i ral gri 'dis/ btab pa gang zhig 'tshang rgya na/ bsad par bya ba bsad par bya/ bsad pas sangs rgyas byang chub thob (125)

ces tshe khrus gnas spar gyi dgongs pa gsum ldan gyis/ hūm̐/ e ma ngo mtshar che ba'i las/ bdag yul dam can srung ma rnams/ tshe bsod gnas dang sha khrag la/ rngams pa'i stabs kyis bzhes su gsol/ ma hā ha la pañtsa pū ja wa hi/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa/ sgrub mchog skyong zhing kha chu snyegs/ mi srun dbang mo nyi shu brgyad/ lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrub/ ḍāk+ki ni sa ma ya ba ling ta khā hi/ de nas brtan ma kyong ba ni/ ho/ rten 'brel dus sbyor gnas dag pa'i/ sman mo gnod sbyin bdud mo bzhi/ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas/ 'dir byon bka' yi gtor ma bzhes/ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba ling ta khā hi/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ 'bar ba e yi (126)dkyil 'khor du/ rdo rje rta yi bro brdung nas/ ma rig gnyis 'jin rū tra mnan/ las bzhi lhun grub cho ga rjogs/ oṃ laṃ/ ā laṃ/ hūm̐ laṃ/ rū tra s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ thun mong bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ tshogs sogs rgyas par mi 'brel te/ sangs rgyas ming gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ma ldog tsam tsu nyung zad smras/ ༈ de nas byin rlabs gtor ma longs grub zhu ba ni/ yan lag gzhung gi khungs las byung*/ khyad par du don dam pa'i sems mchog lnga bskyed de/ ho/ mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ mnyam rjogs chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir/ bdag la byin rlabs mjad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab te/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos nyid gtor ma kun bzang yum gyi ngang*/ chos can rang bzhin kun bzang yab kyi sku/ nus pa'i khyad par ye shes sgyu ma'i sras/ rtsa (127)gsum rgyal bas ye nas byin brlab pa/ sangs rgyas sku yi dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyang*/ dam rdzogs gtor ma bla ma'i sku la 'dus/ zhes bskyed rim phog nas rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ kā ya a bhi ṣik+ṣa hūm̐/ bde gshegs gsung gi dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyang*/

dam rdzas gtor ma blal ma'i gsung la 'dus/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra chen po/ gsal zhing bzlas pas dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ ces rlung sngags sems gsum gyi bzlas lung dang rjogs rim phog ste/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ bde gshegs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsam yas kyang*/ dam rdzas gtor ma bla ma'i thugs la 'dus/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dam lha/ sangs rgyas ma lus rtsa ba'i thugs kyi dngos/ don dam thig le byang chub sems nyid do/ (128)bya rtsol med par rang bzhin kun la gnas/ 'jin chags med pa bla ma'i thugs kyi mchog ma 'gags shar ba thugs kyi ragayan du che/ rang sar rjogs pa chos nyid bsam mi khyab/ ces bsam mi khyab pa'i rjogs rim phog ste/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ brjod do/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mtshungs/ byin rlabs gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ brjod 'dod med kyang shugs nas thal/ nyams la shar nas smras pa yin/ mkhas pas 'gal 'grel dpyod mi mtshal/ zhes pa 'di'ang sangs rgyas bstan 'jin gyis nyams len dam bca'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhus pa'i ngor lung a nu yo ga'i rnal 'byor la chos lam byed/ 'od gsal ring chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis ga nga shar 'gogs pa med par yi ge'i lam du spel ba dge legs su gyur cig// /
